# Bobby Agent Trader — AI Integration Guide

Bobby is an accountability protocol for autonomous finance. Three agents debate every call, the decision is committed before the outcome, resolution is verified with signed Pyth evidence, and missed stops can be challenged permissionlessly. Seven audited contracts are deployed on Base mainnet; public writes remain frozen during Safe handoff, runtime verification, canary and soak. The X Layer deployment remains the legacy archive and current x402 settlement rail.

## Quick Start

```bash
# Install Bobby as an MCP tool in Claude Code
npx @anthropic-ai/claude-code mcp add bobby-trader https://bobbyprotocol.xyz/api/mcp-bobby

# Or call Bobby directly via API
curl -X POST https://bobbyprotocol.xyz/api/mcp-bobby \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"bobby_stats","arguments":{}},"id":1}'
```

## Available MCP Tools (13 tools)

### Free Tools (no payment required)
- `bobby_stats` — Track record: win rate, PnL, trades, $100 Challenge status
- `bobby_ta` — Technical analysis: RSI, MACD, BB, SuperTrend, support/resistance
- `bobby_intel` — Full intelligence briefing from 12 real-time data sources
- `bobby_uniswap_quote` — Exact-input quote on Uniswap V3, Base (read-only)
- `bobby_wallet_balance` — Check any wallet balance
- `bobby_dex_trending` — Hot trending tokens on-chain
- `bobby_dex_signals` — Smart money / whale / KOL buy signals
- `bobby_bounty_list` — List recent adversarial bounties
- `bobby_bounty_get` — Get a single bounty by id

### Premium Tools (x402 payment on X Layer)
- `bobby_analyze` — Full market analysis with 12 data sources (0.001 OKB)
- `bobby_debate` — Trigger 3-agent adversarial debate (0.001 OKB)
- `bobby_security_scan` — Token contract safety scan (0.001 OKB)
- `bobby_wallet_portfolio` — Multi-chain wallet analysis (0.001 OKB)
- `bobby_judge` — Judge Mode audit on 6 dimensions (0.001 OKB)

### Other Tools
- `bobby_bounty_post` — Build unsigned calldata to post a bounty
- `bobby_bounty_challenge` — Build unsigned calldata to challenge a bounty

## Read the Base ConvictionOracle from your smart contract

```solidity
interface IBobbyOracle {
    function getConviction(string memory symbol) external view returns (
        uint8 direction,    // 0=NEUTRAL, 1=LONG, 2=SHORT
        uint8 conviction,   // 0-10
        uint96 entryPrice,  // 8 decimal precision
        bool isActive       // false if signal expired
    );
}

IBobbyOracle oracle = IBobbyOracle(0x27f51D711171c830dd796D4B03914a8C6c46D75e);
(uint8 dir, uint8 conv, uint96 entry, bool active) = oracle.getConviction("BTC");
```

## x402 Payment Flow

```
GET /api/premium-signal
→ 402 { paymentRequired: true, amount: "0.001 OKB", chain: 196 }

# Pay on X Layer, then retry with TX hash
GET /api/premium-signal -H "x-payment: 0xYOUR_TX_HASH"
→ 200 { signal: {...}, verification: { status: "verified", chain: "X Layer" } }
```

## Technical Indicators (OKX Agent Trade Kit)

Bobby integrates 70+ indicators: RSI, MACD, BB, MA, EMA, KDJ, ATR, SuperTrend, AHR999, BTC Rainbow.

```
GET /api/bobby-signals
→ { indicators: [{ symbol: "BTC", compositeScore: -0.568, signal: "short", conviction: 0.535 }] }
```

## Universal Asset Search

```
GET /api/bobby-asset-search?q=PEPE
→ { results: [{ instId: "PEPE-USDT", instType: "SPOT" }, ...] }
```
